digest.component_or_area: rebar-debug skill and agent workflow documentation
propositions: rebar-debug closes bug tickets without recording the originating ticket that introduced the defect, preventing measurement of defect escape rate

the fallback blame derivation mechanically charges defects to whoever wrote most of the file rather than who wrote the defect, and cannot detect when fix site differs from cause site (unmet obligations and missed consumer updates)

the skill must add a required attribution step in Phase 1 Stage 3 exit gate before RCA writeback to identify the originating ticket via git blame and commit history analysis, with explicit --caused-by on the bug close

worktree bootstrap in both rebar-debug and rebar-implement must use make worktree name=<branch> instead of bare git worktree add to provision the virtualenv and run commands with the worktree venv on PATH to avoid pre-commit hook failures
